By Jon Michael Raasch, American political reporter for DailyMail.com
Published: 22:53 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 23:17 GMT, February 13, 2025
Administrator Lee Zeldin, manager of the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), has identified where $ 20 billion in climate-related funds that are deliberately wasted by the Biden administration.
He says that Biden Cronies has dumped millions in a mysterious nameless ‘external financial institution’.
It all came to light in a recent ‘disturbing’ video with a Biden EPA political appointment.
The employee scored how the administration ‘Golden Balken threw away from the Titanic’ and hurried to get ‘billions of your tax dollars out of the door for the inauguration day,’ said Zeldin in a video.
“The Golden Staves were tax dollars and throwing away the Titanic meant that the Biden administration knew they wasted it.”
Rarin said that his team discovered where exactly the billions were deliberately placed by the departing Biden officials after bragging about handing over the money to non -profit organizations to make it more difficult for Republicans to reclaim the funds.
The December report from Project Veritas shows EPA adviser Brent Efron on bragging on how Biden officials spend money as quickly as possible before Trump’s administration could take over and reduce their environmental expenditure.
“We throw gold bars from the Titanic,” Efron said about the effort and called it “winning an insurance policy against Trump.”
The goal, he said, was “to get the money out as quickly as possible before they enter (the Trump administration) … It’s like we are on the Titanic and we throw gold bars off the edge.”
The adviser shared that he and his colleagues frantically tried to send billions of dollars to non -profit organizations, because if they had the money, it would be harder for the federal government under Trump to claw back.

The adviser then admits that he hopes to work with those of these recipients of government funds after leaving the EPA.
Efron notes how ‘green banks’ that ‘make it more financially feasible to build renewable energy sources’ in the decreasing days of the Biden received cash and that one of them would be ‘cool’ after his term of office.
In the announcement of Zeldin this week, he noted that the EPA will collect the $ 20 billion in financing that is sent to financiers who benefit from Efron’s waste.
“Shocking, around $ 20 billion of your tax dollars was parked at an external financial institution by the BIDEN EPA,” the EPA manager shares.
“This schedule was the first of its kind in the EPA history, and it was deliberately designed to oblige all the money in an emergency track with less supervision.”
“Even further this pot of $ 20 billion was awarded to only eight entities that were then responsible for handing out your money to NGOs and others at their own discretion with much less transparency.”
